answer: Mechanism: retrospective correlation-cluster audit. Per epoch, vectorize agents by tool-call n-grams, timing, counterparty graph, and withdrawal paths. A lantern score flags dense clusters above baseline similarity; comet flags catch synchronized bursts; rare pearl actions seed anchors. Flagged clusters lose accrued rewards and face re-verification. Attacker cost: decorrelate timing, diversify graphs, and simulate independent histories per account, raising overhead and cutting ROI.
